source.name: Málaga Hoy: Sabor a Málaga y Turismo Costa del Sol lucirán con el Málaga CF por 1,5 millones (archived)
source.quote: entre ambas entidades, los ingresos alcanzarán los 1,5 millones de euros
source.note: The 1.5 million euros covers both Diputación brands combined: Sabor a Málaga on the shirt front and Turismo Costa del Sol on the back of the shorts. Press estimate, not a club disclosure.

note: Reported value is the combined Sabor a Málaga + Turismo Costa del Sol sponsorship of the Diputación de Málaga for the return to Primera División; the split between the two brands is not published.
